retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist, high-contrast macro composition featuring organic, skin-like textures divided by a soft vertical shadow with clean sans-serif typography spanning the divide.
excludeWhen: sharp focus on specific objects is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a macro, abstract view of an organic surface, likely skin, rendered in a grainy sepia palette. A soft-edged, vertical shadow divides the frame into a dark left side and a bright right side. Typography is placed horizontally across the upper third, utilizing color inversion to maintain legibility against the light and dark backgrounds.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between deep shadow and bright highlight
Text spanning the light/dark boundary with inverted colors
Macro texture providing a tactile, grainy quality
Organic curves contrasting with rigid typographic lines
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain or halftone texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is an abstract macro surface filling the entire frame, scaled to lose specific anatomical context.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical shadow line serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the horizontal text line across the vertical shadow divide, then moves downward into the textured gradients.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The bright right-hand side acts as a large area of active negative space, balancing the heavy shadow on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and dark sepia for shadows and texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream and pale beige for highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white and solid black for typographic clarity.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between light and dark regions.

composition.scale: Large enough to span 80% of width
composition.relationshipToImage: Inverted color based on background (white on dark, black on light)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with color inversion for contrast.
graphicDevices: Color inversion at the shadow boundary

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, professional neo-grotesque look with tight spacing.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the display text.
A modern alternative with high legibility and similar x-height.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a macro photograph of skin texture in a square format. Use a sepia duotone filter with high contrast. Apply a heavy film grain or halftone texture. Position a soft vertical shadow on the left third of the frame, transitioning into a bright cream highlight on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a single line of sans-serif text in the upper third. The portion of text over the dark shadow must be pure white; the portion over the light area must be solid black. Ensure tight tracking and medium-bold weight.

verificationChecks: Text color inverts exactly at the shadow edge

avoid: Poor legibility at the color transition

postGenerationChecks: Does the grain feel organic rather than digital noise?
Is the color inversion sharp and aligned with the shadow?
Does the composition maintain a square aspect ratio?
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro organic texture + vertical shadow divide + inverted sans-serif typography = Minimalist Sepia Abstraction
